Positives: ARCore-certified (strong proxy for sustained >=100 Hz IMU + REALTIME camera timestamps), Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 AE = reliable Qualcomm Venus encoder family (CBR documented; still verify isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) at runtime), full GMS/Play Integrity (post-spinoff Honor, sold with Play Store in India). No in-house thermal data; efficient 4nm midrange SoC suggests 25-min 1080p30 capture is feasible. Device is discontinued/out of stock in India - shrinking fleet relevance.
